feed.unit_source: Not stated in the CSV header. RadLab API docs use '2 uGy/hour' for the filter absorbed_dose_rate>2 (https://visualization.osdr.nasa.gov/radlab/api/), so absorbed_dose_rate is in µGy/h.
feed.quantity: Absorbed dose rate (dose in the detector, not the body's effective dose)
